title: Vigorous Salted Tunisian Lamb Tagine
description: A hearty and savory Tunisian dish featuring lamb, molasses, and a blend of spices, perfect for a post-workout meal. This low-sodium friendly recipe uses a corn husk wrap as a unique vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Rinse the lamb pieces and pat them dry with paper towels.
In a large bowl, whisk together the molasses, olive oil, salt, black pepper, cumin, and coriander.
Add the lamb pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Wrap each lamb piece in a corn husk, making sure to seal the edges.
Place the wrapped lamb pieces in a large baking dish.
Bake the lamb for 2 1/2 hours, or until it is tender and falls apart easily.
Remove the lamb from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
